summary: 'Nice to see you' is NICE then SEE then a point to YOU. Use it with people you already know; 'nice to meet you' is for first meetings.
steps: Sign NICE: dominant palm slides across the other palm.
Sign SEE: V handshape at the eyes moving forward.
Point to the person for YOU with a warm face.
mistakes: Using it on a first meeting. That's NICE-TO-MEET-YOU.
